Changelog

The latest 40 releases.

  • NightlyNightly 2026-11-03 · f42ef42Nov 3, 2026 · 09:30 UTC·nightly

    Want to play? Download the Horizon launcher.

    Do NOT run the files below. They will not work on their own.

    The launcher installs this version and keeps it up to date. You need your own copy of Minecraft: Java Edition. The files below are what the launcher installs, and the dedicated server for people who host one.

    Nightly 2026-11-03 · f42ef42: main (f42ef42), built from nightly/build-2026-11-03-2 (f42ef42).

    Source: commit f42ef42, kept for good as the tag nightly-source/2026-11-03-f42ef42; horizon-source.tar.gz is its tree. Native mods built for this Nightly pin that commit.

    The launcher installs it by itself; your worlds stay as they are. A Nightly can include pull requests the Team picked before they are merged (below). Report bugs with the version the game shows ("Nightly · ").

    • feat(mods): screen key release pre hook (#6014, fixes #6011)

    • Primed TNT keeps its Passengers (#5883)
    • Hoglins and other wide mobs suffocate in walls (#5944, fixes #5872)

    • Boats can't be placed from underwater (#5993, fixes #5967)
    • /datapack enable and disable reload the server's data, as /reload does (#6012, fixes #5995)
    • Draw opaque terrain through a shader that never discards (#6005)
    • Shader API: the material stage reads its own block texture (#5894, fixes #5893)
    • Move players with opening shulker box lids (#5997, fixes #5943)
    • Shader packs: cloudHeight and isElytraFlying uniforms (part of #3172) (#5693)

    • Glint reads the clock and options once per frame, not per item (#4068, fixes #3183)
    • Swapping the same item into the off hand plays the re-equip animation (#4073, fixes #2866)
    • Thrown pearls feel the water their box touches, as vanilla's isInWater (#4082)
    • Command blocks: one data path; the command reaches only the player who opens it (#4183, fixes #4182)
    • Frogs walk their legs at vanilla's rate (#4206, fixes #2848)
    • List worlds with an unreadable level.dat and offer recovery (#4219)
    • A pearl turns the wind charge it hits, which then speeds up (#4222, fixes #3299)
    • Item names in command feedback follow the item_name component (#4252)
    • Render the jeb_ sheep's wool colour, as vanilla does (#4274, fixes #3958)
    • A server's copy of a player jumps with them, so Lunge keeps the jump (#4297, fixes #4278)
    • Pose a brushing arm like vanilla, in both hands (#4325)
    • TNT: stop client piston replay from creating a second primed entity (#4328, fixes #3856)
    • Shulker boxes show their contents to the player who holds them (#4353)
    • Thrown tridents: clip blocks with vanilla's centre ray, not the 0.5 box (#4406, fixes #4365)
    • Runtime spawns run Mob.finalizeSpawn and wither skeletons hit for 4 (#4084)
    • Read the attack speed base from the player's attribute (#4103, fixes #4091)
    • Apply the block_break_speed attribute to mining speed (#4110, fixes #4094)
    • Far terrain: kelp is water, and powder snow and paths are kept (#4144, fixes #4143)
    • Chunk generation 18% faster on many cores: mimalloc as the game's allocator (#4160)
    • Spectating players are hidden from players who aren't spectators (#4204)
    • Time out a server that stops answering, with vanilla's disconnect reasons (#4208)
    • Drowned, zombie and stray conversions keep gear, name and flags (#4209)
    • Tools and armour break with their sound and crumbs on servers (#4213)
    • Sync spawner mob previews after block data commands (#4227, fixes #4215)
    • Draw thrown items where vanilla puts them (#4275, fixes #4130)
    • Many mobs no longer grow the renderer's staging memory until it runs out (#4282, fixes #2826)
    • Block parity: candles, levers, redstone ore dust, note block heads, pots, bells, dripstone, hanging signs, vaults (#3950)
    • Sulfur cubes: synchronize size metadata and adult egg spawns (#3163, fixes #3151)
    • Send a column once its neighbours reach INITIALIZE_LIGHT (#4294) (#4320, fixes #4294)
    • Rendering parity: jeb_ sheep, golem walk tilt, spyglass particle hiding, skulls, brush, witch potion (#3951)
    • Make goat horns play their sound and show the horn pose (#2417)
    • A plain firework rocket from a crossbow flies past the first block, as in vanilla (#4308, fixes #4281)
    • Fix teleport commands without an explicit target (#3550)
    • Camel, horse and llama riding physics as vanilla (#4199)
    • Riding a horse survives a save and a reopen (#2577, fixes #1474)
    • Run the Mouse Tweaks wheel and drags in furnaces and crafting tables, and keep the cursor right under fast clicks (#4363, fixes #4312)
    • Tipped arrows, leather armour, allays, mooshrooms and LAN guests behave like vanilla (#3956)
    • Fix a batch of small mob, block and world-list behaviours so they match vanilla (#3957)
    • Wet wolves darken and shake off the water on clients (#4083)
    • Game started without its files: a launcher screen, not a crash (#4461)
    • Items and damage parity: arrow and potion effects, mob damage sources, adventure can_break and can_place_on, lily pads on water, mud from water bottles (#2990, fixes #3222)
    • A firework rocket with stars bursts on any block it hits, as in vanilla (#4315)
    • Creative players are pushed by explosions and crystals (#4069, fixes #2755)
    • A chat message the server deletes becomes the deleted marker (#4214)
    • Get off a strider onto the shore, not into the lava beside it (#4205)
    • A tame pet's death tells its owner how it died (#4264)
    • The Void superflat preset gets its stone start platform (#4076)
    • /fillbiome recolours loaded chunks for every client (ClientboundChunksBiomesPacket) (#4211)

    Outdated. Horizon now ships as the Nightly release (built from main every few hours): get it through the launcher at https://client.crewnetwork.space or from the Nightly release. GitHub keeps calling this one "Latest" only because Nightly is a pre-release.

    Want to play? Download the Horizon launcher, not the files below

    It installs this version and keeps it up to date. It is also on GitHub: the launcher releases. You need your own copy of Minecraft: Java Edition. The files below are what the launcher installs, and the dedicated server for people who host one.

    Fixed

    • item pickup: a stack in the off hand fills before the inventory, as getSlotWithRemainingSpace does (#3067, fixes #2865)
    • death message: a creeper's blast names the creeper, not the last mob that hit (#3068, fixes #2978)
    • riding: the crosshair skips the mob being ridden, so it can't be hit (#3069, fixes #2870)
    • boat: the view stops at 105 degrees at every turn, so it doesn't jitter (#3070, fixes #2983)
    • HUD paint: build the sprite key in one reused buffer (#3083)
    • Inventory draw: a slot is drawn from a reference, not a copy (#3086)
    • Creative screen: draw the selected tab from a reference (#3092)
    • Server list: build each row's sprite key once (#3095)
    • Effect panels: borrow the name and reuse the icon key (#3097)
    • Name tags: copy a custom name only inside the tag's range (#3100)
    • Crowded mobs take cramming damage, as vanilla (#3124)
    • Shulker bullets are drawn as the spinning bullet model, not a flat sprite (#3127, fixes #3115)
    • fix(windows): open URLs with the registered protocol handler (#3210)
    • Chat and book links: a show_dialog click event opens its dialog (#3238, fixes #3204)
    • Pin the turtle's walk animation to vanilla's rate (#2748, fixes #1776)
    • The spawn egg's offspring is a named, tested rule (#2791, fixes #2269)
    • Signs: keep laid-out sign text between frames (3458 signs: 124 → 222 fps) (#3284, fixes #1461)
    • Prepare: accept Mojang's fifth 26.3 republish (5df1795e, index 917ff6d7) (#3318)

    Known issues

    • Shader packs have been removed for now. They will come back later, written again from scratch. Packs in your shaderpacks folder are left where they are.

CREW Client

Resmi bir Minecraft ürünü değildir. Mojang veya Microsoft tarafından onaylanmamıştır veya bunlarla ilişkili değildir.

Geliştirici & Ekip

Horizon is made by Ludovic Marie; reach him through lu4ovic.com (opens in a new tab). This site is developed by Anthony S of DezerX (opens in a new tab), who is responsible for it. Horizon contains no Minecraft code, assets or data, and this site offers no game files: you need your own legally obtained copy of Minecraft: Java Edition. Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang Synergies AB.

Lisanslar

Horizon's original work is under the MIT licence (opens in a new tab). The fonts are Geist and Geist Mono, under the SIL Open Font License (opens in a new tab). Every asset on this site is listed in LEGAL.md.

Gizlilik

This site sets no cookies, has no analytics or trackers and loads nothing from third parties except GitHub. When you open a release, the server keeps a one-way hash of your IP address so that release counts each visitor once; the address itself is never stored. To show the latest releases, patch notes, links and contributors, your browser asks api.github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com for them, and avatars.githubusercontent.com for the contributors' pictures; GitHub's privacy statement (opens in a new tab) covers those requests. The launcher sends nothing unless you allow it: what it can send, and how to delete it (opens in a new tab).
